_about: Upgrade definitions (F22, TDD 'Upgrades & abilities'; F34: ranks 2–9 as decided in design/upgrades-map.md 'F33 decisions'). type: passive = modifiers (always on) · active = an ability you equip, charge and fire · feature = a flag the screens read. rank = the rank it can be bought from (the shop itself opens at progression.json unlocks.upgrades). maxLevel = how many levels; cost = scraps a level (missing = 1, v1's price). byLevel[n-1] = the value AT level n (not added up). Passive effects: modifier = a name from src/engine/upgrades.ts Modifiers (or a repair's fewer steps), op = 'mul' (multiply) or 'add'. Abilities: charge 0..1 (1 = ready), chargePerSecond while the shift is playing, chargePerSeal per crack sealed; byLevel = the effect's numbers. What players READ (names, descriptions) is in content/text/en.json upgrades.items — 'name' here is only a label for whoever edits this file. Per-level steps start at v1's and get checked by the bots / economy sim (F51). testOnly upgrades are for tests only: nothing in the game lists or grants them.

upgrades.name: Circuit Stabilizer
upgrades._note: v1: +0.75 s of a 5 s grace a level = +15%. Max level: the visor's repair takes 1 step less.

upgrades.name: Auto-Popper
upgrades._note: F33 decision 3 (Muzzy's idea): slower depressurise after a rupture, +15% drain time a level.

upgrades.name: Capacitor Efficiency
upgrades._note: v1: laser drain × (1 − 0.0625 × level). Max level: the laser's repair takes 1 step less.

upgrades.name: Cooldown Booster
upgrades._note: Active. v1: full in 20 s (0.05 a second) + 25% per seal. Fire: every running machine's calm time (the cooldown before it can break again) grows by boost × what's left: +25 / 35 / 50%. The fire effect is F34 task 6.

upgrades.name: Gear Lubrication
upgrades._note: v1: heat drains × (1 + 0.125 × level). Max level: the controls' repair takes 1 step less.

upgrades.name: Focus Mode
upgrades._note: v1: time × (1 − 0.1 × level) at the console. Here: × breakdowns.json consoleTimeScale while you're at the console mid-shift (the App reads it — F34 task 5).

upgrades.name: Dense Goop
upgrades._note: v1: fall speed × (1 + 0.125 × level). A self-chosen challenge you can take back.

upgrades.name: Pressure Control
upgrades._note: F33 decision 2: pressure rises slower (pressureRiseTimeMult > 1 = slower, src/engine/shift.ts), and cracks follow pressure. 8 levels = the scrap sink, so smaller steps: +5% a level (v1: +5 s a level on a 75 s shift ≈ +6.7%).

upgrades.name: Sturdy tank (test)
upgrades.desc: Open cracks wear the tank 50% slower.

upgrades.name: Low cracks (test)
upgrades.desc: When fired, the next 3 cracks form in the bottom 4 rows.
